steps.prompt: Before the check: which pattern from Compensation do you use most, and which do you still have to think about?
steps.placeholder: I use… I still think about…

cards.title: Adding with compensation: quick review
cards.body: Round to a ten, add, then fix: $46 + 9 = 56 - 1$, and $38 + 27 = 40 + 27 - 2$.

cards.title: Taking away with compensation: quick review
cards.body: Take away the ten, then add back the extra: $53 - 9 = 43 + 1$. Or move both numbers the same amount: $62 - 38 = 64 - 40$.

cards.title: How the check works
cards.body: First a short warm-up. Then the check: $8$ questions, easiest first, no hints. Type each answer. You need all $8$ right to pass. If you miss one, you’ll see how to do it, and the next try gives you new numbers.

prompts: Where could you use a pattern from Compensation outside school?
